Definition: a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel
BiblicalUsage: Karmeliyth is a Carmelitess — a woman of Carmel the town. Abigail the Carmelitess lived with David at Gath, and her son Chileab is listed among the sons born to David in Hebron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Abigail's title is her honour: the woman of Carmel who spoke wisely and saved her house is remembered by her town and by her son.
